# oncallalert_schedule_rule (Resource)

A rule that puts a user or rotation on call for a schedule during a daily time window. Import with `<schedule_id>/<rule_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The rotation is on call on weekdays during office hours.
resource "oncallalert_schedule_rule" "office_hours" {
  schedule_id = oncallalert_schedule.backend.id
  target_type = "rotation"
  target_id   = oncallalert_rotation.backend.id
  start       = "09:00"
  end         = "18:00"
  weekdays    = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end` (String) Daily end time, `HH:MM`.
- `schedule_id` (String) Schedule ID.
- `start` (String) Daily start time, `HH:MM` (schedule time zone).
- `target_id` (String) ID of the user or rotation.
- `target_type` (String) `user` or `rotation`.

### Optional

- `weekdays` (Set of String) Days the rule applies: any of `sun`, `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`. Default all.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <schedule_id>/<rule_id>
terraform import oncallalert_schedule_rule.office_hours 3f0c.../9a1b...
```
